metadata.title: Kikiria
metadata.description: A game to look, ask and check what you find online.

home.mascotAlt: Roqui, a little detective rooster holding a magnifying glass.
home.title: Can you figure out which one was made with AI?
dialogue: Hi! I’m Roqui, the detective rooster.
Have you ever seen a photo and wondered if it was real?
Computers can now invent photos that look real.
I’ll teach you how to spot them!

briefing: Mission 1! Find the image made with AI.
You will see two images: one is a photo and the other was made by a computer.
Tap the one you think the computer made.
Getting it wrong is fine: that is how we learn.

r1.observation: Check whether something repeats in exactly the same way.
r1.remember: It is a clue, not proof.

r2.question: Who posted this picture, and what for?

r3.verification: Find where it came from before believing it.
r3.remember: Sometimes looking is not enough to know.

r1.observation: Look at the paws and the ears: does anything look odd?
r1.remember: One odd detail does not always mean AI.

r2.question: Who is sharing this animal picture, and why?
r2.remember: The picture alone does not tell the whole story.

r3.verification: Ask a grown-up where the image came from.
r3.remember: Being unsure is a valid answer too.

r1.observation: Quick: check the background, not only the animal.
r1.remember: Going fast is not the same as not looking.

r2.question: Why would someone want to post this?
r2.remember: Many pictures are made to be shared.

r3.verification: If you run out of time, say you do not know.
r3.remember: Saying "I don't know" beats making it up.

r1.observation: Look at the hands and the feet: they are the hardest to fake.
r1.remember: A clue tells you to keep looking, not to decide.

r2.question: Who gained something by posting this image?
r2.remember: There is always someone behind an image.

r3.verification: Check whether a known outlet published it.
r3.remember: If nobody confirms it, we still do not know.

round1.observation: Some letters do not form words.
round1.remember: It is a clue, not proof.

round2.question: Who published this image, and why?
round2.remember: Appearance does not tell the whole story.

round3.verification: Find the source and review the context.
round3.remember: We cannot always know just by looking.
